notes: Focused public C++ TCK evidence for IEEE 1516.1-2025 §12.12.4.2 p. 380 l. 45-14. Under both HLA_EVOKED and HLA_IMMEDIATE, the case exercises the value operator= and implicit conversion on each of the 25 basic data-element helper classes declared by the pinned Table 26 API, assigns two values per helper, and checks each retrieved value.
